name: 22-go-interface-refactor
prompt: In package store, FileStore keeps values as files in the current directory. Refactor: (1) add an interface named Store with exactly the methods Put(key string, value []byte) error, Get(key string) ([]byte, error) and Delete(key string) error; (2) make *FileStore implement it; (3) add an in-memory MemStore type (pointer receiver) implementing it, where Get of a missing key and Delete of a missing key return errors; (4) add func NewStore(kind string) (Store, error) returning a *FileStore for "file", a *MemStore for "mem", and an error for anything else. Keep the existing behaviour of FileStore. Make sure `go vet ./...` passes.
